prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot hand-painted 2D platformer production prototype tile atlas. Muted moss green, warm brown earth, cool blue-gray stone, painterly texture with crisp readable silhouettes. Strict orthographic FRONT/SIDE ELEVATION, never isometric, top-down, 3D perspective or an environment scene. No characters, text, labels, numbers, borders, grid strokes, ground shadows, glow, scenery or presentation board. Transparent PNG, true alpha-zero in empty space. All cells equal, no gutters, no outer margin; artwork never crosses cell boundaries. ONE SQUARE atlas, exactly FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows,16 cells. Cool teal river water with thin pale-cyan horizontal surface ripple in side elevation; modest brown soil banks match soil tiles. All modules have the same water-line height at one quarter cell height. Air above water is transparent. Water fill has blue/teal semitransparent body, not a glass cube and no visible perspective top. Reading order: Row1 left-bank surface, middle surface repeat, right-bank surface, isolated narrow pool. Row2 underwater full fillA, underwater full fillB, vertical left shoreline, vertical right shoreline. Row3 inner top-left shoreline corner, inner top-right shoreline corner, outer bottom-left shoreline corner, outer bottom-right shoreline corner. Row4 calm surface variantA, calm surface variantB, ripple surface variantA, ripple surface variantB. Four tiles in every row. Same boundary levels and matching water color at connected edges. No reflected scenery, waterfalls, fish or props. Static alternatives, not animation. Intended 64px per cell after export.
